title: Tight Quantum One-Wayness Bound for Multi-Round Sponge
summary: A tight single-round bound is known, but the multi-round sponge bound loses quartically in the quantum-query count; removing this loss remains open.

formal_statement.body: Determine a tight one-wayness bound for the multi-round sponge against a quantum adversary making $q$ quantum queries to a uniformly random permutation $\pi$ and its inverse $\pi^{-1}$. The available bound has a quartic loss in $q$ and is non-tight even for a single round, although a tight single-round bound is known; the unresolved task is to remove this loss in the multi-round setting.

scope.domain: Quantum one-wayness bounds for multi-round sponge constructions in the random-permutation model.
assumptions: The quantum adversary has oracle access to a uniformly random permutation and its inverse.
parameters: q: the number of quantum queries made by the adversary
scope.unresolved_remainder: Obtain a tight multi-round one-wayness bound without the quartic loss in the quantum-query count.

citations.label: Quantum Lifting for Invertible Permutations and Ideal Ciphers

progress.summary: The source presents a bound with a quartic query loss that is non-tight even for one round. It notes a tight single-round result, leaving the tight multi-round bound unresolved.
citation_labels: Alexandru Cojocaru et al., Quantum Lifting for Invertible Permutations and Ideal Ciphers
